name: Ukraine
description: Follow Ukraine, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Ukraine’s Zelenskyy fires his commander in chief after protests and major rift
changes.summary: The firing caps a major crisis for Volodymyr Zelenskyy after Ukrainians took to the streets to call for Oleksandr Syrskyi’s resignation.

changes.title: News Wrap: Gulf Coast prepares for Tropical Storm Bertha
changes.summary: In our news wrap Tuesday, millions along the Gulf Coast are bracing for impacts from Tropical Storm Bertha, Ukrainian President Zelenskyy fired the commander-in-chief of Ukraine's armed forces in the latest shake-up of his top military ranks and New Jersey's governor said more than 6,000 noncitizens were registered to.

changes.title: Mykhailo Drapatyi: What to Know About Ukraine’s New Top General
changes.summary: Maj. Gen. Mykhailo Drapatyi, a decorated commander, is popular both inside and outside of his country.

changes.title: Tech innovator and old guard general are focus of Ukraine's political crisis
changes.summary: When their personalities and policies clashed, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy decided to fire popular young Defense Minister Mykhailo Fedorov and keep Gen. Oleksandr Syrskyi.

changes.title: Zelensky Dismisses Ukraine’s Top General After Protests
changes.summary: The move followed the firing of a popular defense minister, who had clashed with the general over how to fight the war.

changes.title: Ukraine fires 400 drones toward Moscow as Zelenskyy grapples with protests
changes.summary: The blitz came hours after Russia bombarded Kyiv and other Ukrainian cities with ballistic missiles in a relentless cycle of tit-for-tat strikes.

changes.title: What it's like inside Ukraine during a massive Russian ballistic missile attack
changes.summary: Russia targeted Kyiv, Ukraine, in one of its largest missile assaults of the war over the weekend, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said. CBS News' Aidan Stretch has the latest from Kyiv.

changes.title: Funding milestone detected
changes.summary: At a conference on reconstruction, the focus shifted to private investment, not donor assistance.

changes.title: Zelensky Faces Pressure to Remove Ukraine’s Top General
changes.summary: Demonstrators and many soldiers want President Volodymyr Zelensky to reaffirm the vision of drone warfare laid out by the defense minister he fired last week.

changes.title: Russian attacks on Ukrainian cities kill 6 and expose defense gaps
changes.summary: One person was killed and 16 others wounded in the overnight Russian attack on Kyiv, local authorities said.
